entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The dark blue single-seat open-wheel race car carrying the current cockpit viewpoint, with its open cockpit, two black front wheels, and protective frame with a central pillar visible.

entities.name: gray paved racetrack
entities.identification: The gray road surface exposed in front of and on both sides of Vehicle A; a left-hand bend and its gradually opening exit are visible in this segment.

entities.name: light blue sky
entities.identification: The large expanse of light blue sky within the opening of Vehicle A's protective frame and above the distant ground features.

entities.name: Person A

entities.name: multi-button steering wheel
entities.identification: The black irregularly shaped steering wheel held by Person A, with colored buttons, circular knobs, and white characters on its face.

entities.name: Vehicle B
entities.identification: The low dark open-wheel race car in front of Vehicle A, whose image position gradually moves from image-left to left of center.

entities.name: red-and-white curb
entities.identification: The narrow strip of alternating red-and-white pavement on the inside of the left-hand bend.

entities.name: grass beside the racetrack
entities.identification: The low green to yellow-green strip of grass outside the road, distinct from the bright green paved area.

entities.name: trees beside the racetrack
entities.identification: The green trees distributed in clusters around the outside of the road and in the distance, with crowns of varying heights.

entities.name: racetrack safety barrier
entities.identification: The low continuous barrier around the outside of the road, with light-colored wall sections, green advertising surfaces, and some orange wall sections visible.

entities.name: racetrack metal mesh fence
entities.identification: The openwork fence around the outside of the road, supported by spaced vertical posts and featuring fine horizontal lines.

entities.name: colored paved runoff area
entities.identification: The bright green, level paved area outside the red-and-white curb on image-left.

entities.name: racetrack sign
entities.identification: The green rectangular advertising surface around the outside of the road, bearing repeated pale yellow patterns and wording.

entities.name: distant hills
entities.identification: The pale gray-blue, gently undulating ridge behind the distant trees and fence.

entities.name: spectators beside the racetrack
entities.identification: The dense, distant crowd of spectators on the sloped area behind the outer barrier, without separating individuals.
